title: fix(common): publish native general settings atomically

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The isolated retry candidate and six regression-test sources remain unvalidated. Static review identified that the supersession test's later callback cannot establish that an earlier failed notification already queued a retry. There is no exposed retry-state handshake, and a test-only production hook was not added without justification. A timeout can detect failure but cannot supply the missing ordering proof. No further edits or runtime checks were made; the candidate must gain defensible deterministic proof before it can support an author-facing correction.
